skill.name: xhs-viral-copy-breakdown
skill.description: Analyze public Xiaohongshu notes by topic, link, or note ID using SocialDataX. Identify title hooks, openings, selling points, and calls to action.
skill.summary: Turn patterns in Xiaohongshu posts into reusable copywriting frameworks.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown formatting, documentation, or readable Chinese text. The CLI runs an unpinned npm package and uses credentials from the environment or a persistent local file. Shell argument handling and full tokenized URL sharing create additional risks; no evidence of audit-targeting prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: The CLI runs an unpinned npm package with access to local credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before installing or running the CLI. Pin and verify the package and dependency tree, then run it with minimal filesystem and environment access.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access credentials from environment variables and a persistent local file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated, least-privilege service credential and an OS credential store or managed secret injection. Verify that status checks and logs never disclose credentials.

remediation.issue: Shell examples include placeholders for untrusted input.
remediation.suggestion: Use structured MCP calls or launch a verified CLI with a fixed argument array and shell interpretation disabled. Validate note IDs and allowed URL hosts.

remediation.issue: The report rules require retention and forwarding of tokenized note URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Use note IDs or verified public links in shareable reports. Keep full tokenized URLs only for retrieval, and require explicit consent before storing or forwarding them.

content.value_statement: Popular Xiaohongshu posts can be hard to compare without a clear structure. This skill organizes visible copy and engagement data into reusable writing patterns.
actual_capabilities: Search public Xiaohongshu notes by keyword or topic and filter by post type or publication time.
Retrieve a specific note using its link, share text, or full note ID.
Build a sample table with titles, authors, engagement metrics, and publication dates when available.
Identify visible title hooks, opening techniques, selling points, emotional language, and calls to action.
Map how the visible copy is organized and flag sections that are missing.
Suggest three to five reusable copywriting structures and recommend a next research step.
limitations: Live retrieval requires network access and authenticated SocialDataX CLI or MCP access. API usage may consume credits.
Search results cover a limited sample. Engagement counts do not prove that the copy caused the results.
The skill cannot analyze hidden text and does not retrieve comments or perform Xiaohongshu account actions.
It provides writing frameworks, not finished posts, cover designs, account diagnoses, or traffic guarantees.

use_cases.title: Plan a First Post
use_cases.description: Study openings and calls to action in a small sample of public notes before outlining an original post.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Messaging
use_cases.description: Compare how posts present benefits and proof for similar products. Adapt the structure to claims your brand can support.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Editorial Brief
use_cases.description: Compare engagement and writing patterns across a defined time window. Separate repeated observations from conclusions that need more evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Note
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a single public post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this public Xiaohongshu note: [note link]. Explain its title hook, opening, and call to action. Mark any text you cannot see.

prompt_templates.title: Explore One Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: find common patterns for a specific audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for [topic] for [audience]. Use at most two pages and 20 notes. List recurring title hooks and suggest three reusable structures.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Note Types
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: distinguish messaging patterns across formats.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare public image and video notes for [keyword] from the past week. Report sample sizes and compare visible selling points and openings. Mark missing text.

prompt_templates.title: Test a Pattern Across Samples
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: check whether an observation depends on sorting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare recent notes with highly liked notes for [keyword] using the same date range and post type. Show sample sizes, recurring structures, and limits on the conclusions.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review a public note titled Three Lunches I Prepare on Sunday.
output: Title hook: A specific number and a Sunday routine make the topic concrete.
Opening: Not available in the returned text, so the opening technique cannot be verified.
Reusable structure: Name a recurring task, specify the number of options, and state when you prepare them.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare writing patterns in a sample of public notes about compact desks.
output: Sample observation: Three of six notes frame the product around limited room space.
Selling point: Visible descriptions emphasize usable surface area and convenient storage.
Next step: Compare with a recent sample to see whether the same pattern appears outside the highly liked results.

best_practices: Start with one focused keyword or public note, then define the sample size before expanding the search.
Separate visible evidence from interpretation and mark gaps when the full note text is unavailable.
Review reports for tokenized links and use note IDs instead when sharing outside the original audience.
anti_patterns: Treating a small sample of highly liked notes as representative of all Xiaohongshu posts.
Copying a creator's exact phrasing instead of adapting the underlying structure.
Pasting API keys into chat or sharing full tokenized links in public documents.

faq.question: What inputs can I use?
faq.answer: Start with a topic, keyword, audience, product direction, public note link, or full note ID.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX account?
faq.answer: Live retrieval needs an authenticated SocialDataX connection. Use a configured MCP connection or a CLI credential stored outside the chat.

faq.question: How many notes are searched by default?
faq.answer: For a keyword search, the default is two pages and up to 20 notes, sorted by likes unless you request another order.

faq.question: What happens when note text is missing?
faq.answer: The report marks missing fields and only analyzes visible text. It does not infer openings or structure from unseen copy.

faq.question: Does this skill publish posts or read comments?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes visible note copy without retrieving comments, publishing posts, or changing Xiaohongshu account data.

faq.question: Does it predict whether my post will perform well?
faq.answer: No. It identifies patterns in the current sample and suggests structures to test. It does not predict traffic or engagement.
